svg.text: 40-pin Pico-style header — pinout and power input
VSYS is the board's 5 V system rail
buck (3 A max) that makes 3V3, and the
RT9193 LDO for the audio codec.
Upper limit set by the 10 V X5R input
caps, a 5.0 V TVS, and the 3V3 LDO —
Lower limit ~4 V: below that the linear
Do not feed 12 V — nothing on the 5 V
Do not drive VBUS (pin 40) as a supply;
it is tied to the USB-C connector.
3V3 (pin 36) is an OUTPUT, not an input.
Pin numbering follows the Pico-style header (U10). GPIO names are ESP32-P4 nets.
Verified against ESP32-P4-WIFI6-datasheet.pdf (schematic, U10) and the Waveshare pinout.
